text: Given your AIDS history and the fundoscopic findings of granular yellow-white opacities with hemorrhages, this presentation is highly characteristic of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis
